plan_status: Summary of the main terms, not the plan text. The lock commit sits in a private repository; no public ref pins it. Post-lock amendments and implementation readings are labelled below.

Nested lock values identify private run provenance, not a public plan-text reference.

question: What does an evaluation pay back with no edge, through the first payout?
result_scope: Every result of the corrected runs is traceable below. The defective first runs and their progress values are excluded and never quoted here. Superseded addendum-1 unit-test attempts and extra sanity re-runs are summarised as corrections, not reprinted. The final reported checks are included.
only_one_set_scope: Defined after the results to check the film's "only one" sentence; not a registered set: 131 no-edge, trailing-floor cells chosen by parameters. The one whole-period point above a dollar is B_multipay_C1, a report-only variant. Whole-period cells and point estimates only. Registered/check cells and report-only variants with no edge and a trailing floor are included; edge-grid cells, static-floor counterfactuals and the quick-sum formula are excluded. The era splits in the design download are sub-period readings and are not members. Among those excluded splits, B_discount_C1 for 2011-2017 starts is a report-only half-price variant: with no edge, on BluSky Launch 50K dated 2026-10-10, QQQ stand-in stop-first, one trade a day, through the first payout, its EVF point is 1.03 [0.91, 1.16] (95% interval), TOO CLOSE TO CALL. Its point exceeds a dollar, but its interval straddles a dollar. This split is not a second member of the whole-period set.

ledger_dictionary.row: Sequential display row, not a purchase count
ledger_dictionary.arm: A: parametric model; B: ETF paths
ledger_dictionary.cell_id: Stable configuration identifier used throughout the downloads
ledger_dictionary.group: primary, q2, e3, flag, or ro configuration family; ro prefixes mark supplementary variants
ledger_dictionary.cadence: C1 one/day; C2 repeated intraday entries with the stated stops
ledger_dictionary.bracket: A reward/risk multiple or B stop/target point pair
ledger_dictionary.floor: trailing or static counterfactual in evaluation/Buffer
ledger_dictionary.path_ticker: QQQ/SPY path; none for the parametric model
ledger_dictionary.futures_level: Reference level L converting the point bracket into price fractions; an estimate
ledger_dictionary.same_bar_resolution: stop-first, target-first or 50/50 order of a bar touching both levels
ledger_dictionary.account_start_window: Earliest and latest eligible start; not the ending date of price data
ledger_dictionary.n: Simulated purchase denominator for this configuration
ledger_dictionary.first_payouts: Purchases receiving at least one payment; never a count of payment events, including in B_multipay rows
ledger_dictionary.P_first_payout: first_payouts / n: probability a purchase receives at least one payment, including in B_multipay rows
ledger_dictionary.mean_paid: Trader payments / original purchases, in dollars, including failures; through first payout except B_multipay rows, which include all payments until breach or review
ledger_dictionary.mean_first_payout_received: First-payment dollars conditional on receiving payment (zero if no recipient); B_multipay_C1/C2 instead hold all payments per paying purchase until breach or the $10,000 review, not a first-payment amount
ledger_dictionary.EVF: mean_paid / mean_fees over the stated payout horizon, in payout dollars per fee dollar; whole-period point estimate, with era estimates separately stored in JSON
ledger_dictionary.shortlist_form: P_pass * mean_first_payout_received / mean_fees; omits post-pass failures. B_multipay_C1/C2: stored P_pass * all payments per paying purchase / mean_fees arithmetic; the first-payout shortlist_form is not defined for multi-payout rows
ledger_dictionary.registered_or_report_only: Whether the configuration belongs to the registered grid/checks or supplementary variants
ledger_dictionary.label: Diagnostic classification from this cell EVF interval; combined labels are in section 5
ledger_dictionary.flags: Pointer to the combined Q3/Q4 flags, not a replacement for them
ledger_dictionary.source_key: Canonical arm and cell key for reconciliation
ledger_dictionary.entry_win_probability: Model grid p if specified; otherwise random-entry null
ledger_dictionary.parameters: Exact configuration: cad=cadence; b=reward/risk; r=dollar risk; p/p_ph=win probabilities; b_ph=phase brackets; comm=commission; cons=consistency reading; L=reference level; eval/buf/sim=phase point brackets; P=variant overrides
ledger_dictionary.conditions: Population, dated plan, horizon, arm and cadence; configuration overrides are in parameters

first_payout.applies_to: Whole-period cells other than B_multipay_C1 and B_multipay_C2
first_payout.mean_first_payout_received: First-payment dollars conditional on receiving a payment; zero sentinel if there were no recipients.
first_payout.shortlist_form: P_pass * mean_first_payout_received / mean_fees; first-payout quick-sum formula, omitting post-pass failures.

multi_payout.mean_first_payout_received: all payments per paying purchase until breach or the $10,000 review, not a first-payment amount
multi_payout.shortlist_form: stored P_pass * all payments per paying purchase / mean_fees arithmetic; the first-payout shortlist_form is not defined for multi-payout rows
multi_payout.mean_paid: All trader payments until breach or review / original purchases, including failures.
multi_payout.first_payouts: Purchases with at least one payment, not the number of payment events.
multi_payout.P_first_payout: Probability a purchase received at least one payment, not a payment-event frequency.

era.applies_to: Non-null sub-period entries in path cell_diagnostics.era; same parameters and payout horizon as the parent cell, restricted to starts in that era.
era.absent_fields: mean_first_payout_received and shortlist_form are not stored in era objects.
era.sum_paid: Sum of trader payments over the parent horizon among purchases starting in this era; all payments for B_multipay parents.
era.sum_paid1: Number of purchases receiving at least one payment, never the number of payments.
era.EVF: sum_paid / sum_fees within the era; this is a sub-period estimate, not an additional whole-period cell.
era.empty_era: The first slot (2004-2010) is null after addendum 4; null means no eligible starts, not a zero return.

scope: BluSky Launch 50K, rules retrieved 2026-10-10; no test of JJ Simon's entries, skill or payouts; no purchase-count or sizing recipe.

definitions.purchase: One evaluation attempt followed, if passed, through Buffer and Sim Funded to first payment, breach or cap in the first-payout rows; B_multipay rows continue payments until breach or review.
definitions.EVF: Mean trader payout / mean fees over purchases, failures included. Not mean individual payout/fee ratios.
definitions.shortlist_form: For first-payout rows: P(pass) * mean first payment conditional on payment / mean fees; omits Buffer and funded failures. B_multipay_C1/C2 instead retain stored P_pass * all payments per paying purchase / mean_fees arithmetic; the first-payout shortlist_form is not defined for multi-payout rows.

account_rules.ratchet: Highest end-of-day balance; breaches include open P&L for paths; no floor lock in primary
account_rules.consistency: largest profitable day / sum of profitable days; 50% evaluation, 34% Buffer; no Sim Funded consistency

A.trades: independent win/loss draws; p=1/(1+b) before costs
A.cadence: C1 one/day; C2 until three losses, target or breach, without a clock

B.assumption: QQQ stands in for NQ futures; SPY is a correlated alternative, not independent validation
B.prices: one-minute ETF bars; no futures tape held
B.starts: 2011-03-23 to 2023-06-14 (post-lock addendum 4 correction after headline results)
B.starts_at_lock: 2004-01-02 to the last session leaving 756 sessions before 2026-06-22; the original calendar incorrectly joined a data gap
B.reference_level_basis: Estimate from last stored QQQ close 736.469 on 2026-06-22 times approximate index/fund ratio 41; futures basis ignored
B.entry_window: 09:30-10:59 ET; uniform first minute, random direction
B.C2: next bar after exit until three consecutive losses, target, breach or window end
B.fills: entry open; scan entry bar; touched levels fill at level; adverse stop gaps at open; favourable target gaps at target; floor before target
B.time_exit: last regular-hours close (15:59 or half-day close); open P&L tested on regular-hours bars
B.missing_bars: skip missing bars; require 09:30; never condition eligibility on later bars
B.caps: Locked: 252 trading sessions per phase, runway 756 sessions, renewals charged, no censoring. Post-lock addendum 4: enforce an unbroken common calendar; earlier-era block becomes empty.
B.coverage_status: Corrected post-run coverage under post-lock addendum 4, not original locked dates

random_seeds.streams: Locked: one stream per simulated purchase reused across cells, drawing entry minutes and coins in order of use. Post-lock addendum 1(a): per-purchase keys spawned from the seed; draws are a counter-based hash of key, purpose and index.

intervals: 95%; A Wilson for proportions, percentile bootstrap ratios/differences; B start-month block bootstrap; 2,000 resamples

decision_rules.Q1: Locked: compare intervals with 30-36% pass and 6-12% first-payout bands; BELOW/NEAR/ABOVE. Post-lock addendum 3, after two nonheadline progress values: report each resolution
decision_rules.Q3: D1=25/38 minus 25/25 pass rate; D4=25/38 minus 25/100. RAISES if both lower bounds >0; else FALSE if either upper bound <.02; else INCONCLUSIVE. Trailing effects subtract static-floor differences; TRAILING-DRIVEN if both lower bounds >0; else NOT THE TRAIL if either upper <.02.
decision_rules.Q4: UNDERPRICED if EVF lower bound >1; OVERPRICED if upper bound <1; otherwise TOO CLOSE TO CALL. Primary horizon first payout.
decision_rules.Q2: A only; p*=smallest .40:.01:.60 grid p with EVF lower bound >1 there and at every larger grid value. Also point threshold. Alternative phase bracket report-only.
decision_rules.invariance: Q3/Q4 must agree across same-bar resolutions; otherwise inconclusive/too-close with BAR-COARSE. Preserve arm and cadence disagreement; no combined Q3 verdict.

checks.U1: fixed floor, b=1, no costs/consistency: expected .4 +/-3 standard errors at N=200000
checks.U2: Locked: synthetic driftless paths, symmetric bracket .500 +/-3 standard errors, and account pass .4. Post-lock addendum 1: replace degenerate pooling and invalid independent-binomial tolerance with direction-specific session-clustered uncertainty, before study results.
checks.M1: zero-edge A probability <=(2000+r)/(5000+r); failure stops work and requires disclosed correction
checks.P1: print coverage below 85 of 90 entry-window bars
checks.P2prime: Locked: gross R/trade including time exits; PATH-BIASED if abs(mean)>.02 and interval excludes zero. Post-lock addendum 3, after two nonheadline progress values: use the 50/50 resolution for P2prime.
checks.P2: single-touch target share diagnostic against 25/63; not a flag
checks.P3: both-touch share >5% flags BAR-COARSE; invariance still applies below that
checks.P4: QQQ-SPY paired pass difference >3 points with interval excluding zero flags PATH-SENSITIVE
checks.P5: label changes over reference levels flag LEVEL-SENSITIVE
checks.P6: Locked: 2004-2010, 2011-2017 and 2018-last start; label changes flag ERA-SENSITIVE; print tick size; >=5 ticks report-only. Post-lock addendum 4: 2004-2010 becomes empty after calendar correction.

priors.E3: Locked expectation: pass rate moves more with $250->$1,000 risk than with +5 percentage points edge. Post-run outcome: NOT MET (E3 failed).

implementation_readings: Post-lock addendum 1(a): per-purchase keys spawned from the seed; draws use a counter-based hash of key, purpose and index instead of drawing in order of use.
Post-lock addendum 1(b): C2 first entry is C1 drawn minute; the original chaining rule did not specify the first minute.
Post-lock addendum 1(c): PM entry is uniform over PM bars, moved past the AM exit when needed; the three-loss stop ends the whole day.
Post-lock addendum 1(d): static counterfactual fixes evaluation and Buffer floors.
Post-lock addendum 1(e): intraday-touch pass is identical by construction, not a separate run.
Post-lock addendum 1(f): E3 p0+.05 cell is run; the expectation named it but the original grid list omitted it.
Post-lock addendum 1(g): renewals dated on or before the last evaluation session are charged.
Post-lock addendum 1(h): paid reset variant starts a cycle at $49.
Post-lock addendum 1(i): multi-payout payments are at least five sessions apart, each at least $500 and with $500 new profit between them; stop at breach or the $10,000 review.
Post-lock addendum 1(j): tick-worse uses a 25.25-point stop at one NQ, a $505 risk.

amendments.what: U2a pooling was degenerate; independent-binomial tolerance invalid for overlapping session entries; changed to direction-specific session-clustered uncertainty before study results.
Evaluation pass was incorrectly reused as same-day Buffer pass. Transition masks now use original phase; scripted failing test added, A rerun.
After two nonheadline progress values were visible, fixed P2prime (P2') reading to 50/50 and Q1 to each resolution.
Calendar joined 2004 to 2011 across missing QQQ sessions. Eligible starts now require unbroken 756-session runway; B rerun. Earlier-era block empty.
C1 level/era labels accidentally used C2 cadence. Rebuilt labels from unchanged simulation outputs: C1 FALSE at three levels and 2011-2017; 2018-2023 inconclusive. ERA-SENSITIVE remains.

E1.statement: zero-edge P(pass) materially non-zero (headline P_pass lower bound >= 5%)

E2.statement: zero-edge extraction net of fees negative (EVF point < 1)

E3.statement: P(pass) more sensitive to bet size than to edge (arm A, trailing, C1)

E4.statement: M1 bound holds in every zero-edge arm-A cell
